paragraphs.text: "My mother once told me angels sing their swords' names with each strike." —Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*
"And the flamingos said, 'Get out of our nest—we can't be seen with the likes of you!' So, the griffin ate them." —Azeworai, "The Ugly Bird"
"That does it! I'm going back to hunting chickens!" —Rhirhok, goblin archer
"Harah swung his sword mightily, but still the air held him fast." —Azeworai, "Kenechi's Dream"
"The true dishonor for a soldier is surviving the war." —Telim'Tor
The lion blinked —Femeref expression meaning "situation avoided"
"If it bears wings, I will pin it to the skies over Tefemburu." —Ruya, Zhalfirin archer
"You stop breathing for just a few minutes and everyone jumps to conclusions." —Zarkuu, necrosavant
There is no wall that can't be improved by making it taller.
"By the tongues of a thousand serpents, this time I do not lie." —Ahmahz il Kin, Suq'Ata diplomat
Asmira's prayers alone should have freed Mangara from the amber prison . . .
"These things will protect you while I'm gone, remind you of my love for you." —"Love Song of Night and Day"
"My soldiers fought without hesitation, died without doubt." —Sidar Jabari
"Tread upon the meek, and they shall wound your feet and make you crawl." —Asmira, Holy Avenger
"Good is not a 'thing.' You can neither touch nor own it. No, Good is a vision we all share and strive to make real." —Asmira, Holy Avenger
"And darkness shall be cast from me For my soul resides in the Sun." —Femeref dirge
"They may seem ceremonial, but their swords are still sharp." —Kipkemboi, Kukemssa pirate
"We are to be bound together as the reeds of a basket." —Asmira, Rashida, and Jabari, unity chant
"War is the crucible of leadership." —Rashida Scalebane
"Sometimes a burden can be borne only on the shoulders of a willing enemy." —Suq'Ata aphorism
"He blows a gust across the cliff to vanish in a breath of wind." —"Song of the Wind Being"
For the chronatog, there is no meal like the present.
"You know you've angered the gods when the clouds turn against you." —Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*
First the insult, then the injury.
"Some say the sea is jealous of the land and wishes to climb its heights to meet the sky." —Afari, *Tales*
"Controlling time ensures you need never look impulsive again." —Teferi
"Madness and genius are separated only by degrees of success." —Sidar Jabari
Fear the mists, for they are armed.
"Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch." —Naimah, Femeref philosopher
"Magic is my thread, my will the needle. I weave over you as if you never were." —Poetics of Hanan
"Wealth is a good thing, compared to poverty—your food is better, your robes are softer, and your companions have bathed more recently." —Kipkemboi, Kukemssa pirate
"A beauty made more so by its fleeting visitations." —Teferi
Life or death: which is the illusion?" —Naimah, Femeref philosopher
"Kaervek believes the drakes' cries herald his victory; in truth, they mourn aloud for his impending demise." —Teferi
"Fire is dead. Water has killed him." —From *The Stories of Nature*
"Time may heal all wounds, but what heals time?" —Teferi
"Oft have I wished to undo past deeds, but never did I imagine they would be undone for me." —Naimah, Femeref philosopher
"Careless, like a child with fire, so was I with time." —Teferi
"Fly us higher, out of its storm." —Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*
"Your arrogance amazes me, Kaervek. Did you not know the price you would pay?" —Mangara
"Kaervek imprisoned Mangara out of jealousy, but he taints Jamuraa simply out of spite." —Asmira, Holy Avenger
"It's like waking on a bed of a thousand olives during an earthquake of subtle force." —Afari, *Tales*
A rhino's bargain —Femeref expression meaning "a situation with no choices"
"Once I dreamt of death, but now it dreams of me / And only rats and rotting flesh can hear my silent plea." —Mundungu chant
"As you breathe your last, understand why I accept such forbidden gifts." —Purraj of Urborg
"Watch death wait / Wait, death, watch / Steal breath swiftly / but steal life slowly." —Suq'Ata dirge
"Kill a creature, destroy the present. Kill the land, destroy the future." —Kaervek
In troubled times, there are few greater sorrows than a wayward savior.
"I offered you eternal life; I just didn't say *where*." —Shauku, Endbringer
"The end justifies the means. What do I care if I rule over the dead rather than over the living? The dead ask fewer questions." —Kaervek
"Ah, I remember my first death." —Zarkuu, necrosavant
"I have seen the horrors Kaervek has freed. My betrayal is certain—but of Kaervek or of Jamuraa, I cannot say." —Jolrael
"Aku, City of Hidden Graves / Aku, City of Lost Kings / Aku, welcome me." —Pillar tomb inscription
"How can you claim the gods are merciless when they robbed the snake of its limbs to give the other creatures a sporting chance?" —Hakim, Loreweaver
"The cyclops shrugged off savage blows, but casual insults made him weep." —Azeworai, "The Cyclops who Couldn't"
"My pet will pick the ripe fruit from your tortured brain as if it were hanging from a vine." —Kaervek
"I write upon clean white parchment with a sharp quill and the blood of my students, divining their secrets." —Shauku, Endbringer
"So the vulture said to the griffin, 'You gonna eat that?'" —Azeworai, "The Ugly Bird"
"The blood on my hands is merely proof of my ambition." —Kaervek
Some dwarves can only be pushed so far.
Embermages aren't well known for their diplomatic skills.
"Next!"
"May you get the mount you deserve." —Suq'Ata curse
"Some say a great cyclops turns the world in its hands, looking down upon it with its one bright eye." —Afari, *Tales*
Wanted: Thick-skinned goblin for guarding mean ol' Kookus. Must like fires. Must heal quickly.
The mightiest clouds sit upon spires of fire. —Femeref adage
"Why is loud stupidity so infectious?" —Rana, Suq'Ata market fool
"Ate up all of his siblings in the first week. A good beginning for one destined to command." —Suka, ogre matron
"Every temper tantrum makes another angry gorilla." —Femeref children's myth
"Flog and Squee / Up the tree / See the army / Flee, flee, flee." —Goblin nursery rhyme/war cry
"Good ol' rock. Nothing beats rock." —Rhirhok, goblin archer
"A burst of hot air tossed the moon into the air, and the moon liked it up there so much it never needed the ground again." —Azeworai, "Glitter Moon"
Purraj sang slaughter and danced death.
It prefers its meals cooked.
"Never stop 'til you see your lance come out the other side." —Telim'Tor
In the Talruum language, there is no word for "surprised."
When the Talruum began to play, the dragons fell from the sky to squash the obnoxious noise.
"Where do you run when the earth becomes your enemy?" —Naimah, Femeref philosopher
"Some believe Sandstalkers to be illusions; those with scars know better." —*Zhalfirin Guide to the Desert*
Four gray trees and a long, coiling snake. What am I? —Zhalfirin riddle
"My horizon was the arcing petals, my new home resplendent with spires of weeds and pillows of fragrant pollen." —Naimah, Femeref philosopher
"Mold could catch you." —Suq'Ata insult
"How have I angered nature that she would imprison me in a labyrinth of grass?" —Kasib ibn Naji, Letters
"The elves can hide better than most can look." —Mwani, Mtenda herder
"If a rhino's head is lower than its shoulders, trust me—it is *not* praying." —Mwani, Mtenda herder
"'I've seen hornworms big as a man's fist,' the traveler said, and nodded soberly when our jaws went slack at his ignorance." —Afari, *Tales*
Wind will win, whatever we wish.
If you find yourself and a friend being chased by a King Cheetah, you have but one chance: Trip your friend. —Suq'Ata wisdom
"Their tears spill over Jamuraa. Mixed with blood, they wash everything red." —"Love Song of Night and Day"
. . . but the price of Mangara's freedom was Asmira's life.
"When you run you're graceful and swift, sleek as a powerful panther." —"Love Song of Night and Day"
"The land has been gracious enough to let you tread upon her for years. That privilege is about to end." —Liefellen, Quirion exarch
"Respect the earth, for it will one day be your shield and another day your blanket." —Liefellen, Quirion exarch
"But no one heard the snake's gentle hiss for peace over the elephant's trumpeting of war." —Afari, *Tales*
"I've dreamt of a second harvest but fear I will not see it." —Asmira, Holy Avenger
Prayers for rain are answered with the thunder of hooves.
"Our love is like the river in the summer season of long rains. / For a little while it spilled its banks, flooding the crops in the fields." —"Love Song of Night and Day"
"Is it true that the apes wear furs of gold when they marry?" —Rana, Suq'Ata market fool
"Too much work—it takes a long time to break them in, and more than a few recruits." —Grebog, goblin swine-rider
"As the winds abated, there was a shower of dragonscales, then nothing more." —Azeworai, "The Unruly Wind"
"Do not underestimate the power of many against one." —Sidar Jabari
"Far too many soldiers have died in their beds." —Telim'Tor
"Then she spread a fine dust over the land, like a butterfly shaking its wing." —"The Enchantress," Femeref tale
"If it can scar the sky with fire, do not share its destination." —Mwani, Mtenda herder
"Retainer of eternal Sun! Life flash again upon thy wings." —"Song to the Sun," Femeref song
"Our buried kings silently await the revolt of dead peasants." —Tuwile, mundungu of Aku
"This is a war without neutrality." —Asmira, Holy Avenger
"With Rashida's blades, my guiding vision and the luck of the blessed, today we will free Mangara!" —Asmira, Holy Avenger
"The black-and-white sacred monkey holds her children to her, and waits." —"Love Song of Night and Day"
"He traded sand for skins, skins for gold, gold for life. In the end, he traded life for sand." —Afari, *Tales*
With Suleiman's ascension to power, the djinn and efreets of ancient Rabiah learned humility.
"Its speed will be equaled only by the swiftness of my enemy's fall." —Kaervek
The Viashivan understand that cruelty arises from opportunity.
"A pretty toy. Now show me its tactical applications." —Telim'Tor
"With no further options, I was forced to don the mask." —Rashida Scalebane
"This little prize will cover your head, your spells, your bets, and your behind!" —Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader
"If my heart had a lid, I would lift it and show you my joy." —From Suq'Ata wedding ceremony
BOOM!
Some potmakers claim to use the mud of such creatures to make their finest bowls—and that the bowls scream when fired.

"I have heard terrible tales of black rains, ashen fields, and metal that screams. I have consoled myself that the tales were a myth of some fevered mind. But today I saw a walker—and now I fear the truth." —Kasib Ibn Naji, Letters
"But once, with a magician's help, Time was stopped and Day stood still." —"Love Song of Night and Day"
"With this ring, you have friends in worlds you've never heard of." —Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*
"Uh, does anyone have a flute?" —Rana, Suq'Ata market fool
The Zhalfirin war triangle represents a trinity of might, faith, and guile.
You'll never miss what you never had.
"Where are falling feathers deadlier than falling rock?" —*The One Thousand Questions*
Jolrael's choice of homes was far better than her choice of allies.
